answer: Each of 430 aliases needs its own repair logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The nectar is the wall and the quill is the gate: A dry stone walling association tenure with wall repair logs works as the gate: walls repaired under one association for years. A farm of 430 aliases must climb the wall 430 times, the walnut ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
